name: Hygge Game
source:
A visual novel about a guy moving to Copenhagen and meeting a girl who teaches him about hygge.

The visual novel contains two possible endings.

From [url=https://maya-dk.itch.io/hygge-game]itch.io[/url]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了一个男人搬到哥本哈根并遇到了一个教他有关hygge的女孩的故事。

视觉小说包含两种可能的结局。

来自 [url=https://maya-dk.itch.io/hygge-game]itch.io[/url]
